ux_intent: Validate that the on-screen keyboard is large and D-pad navigable, search results appear in a grid that is readable at 10-foot distance, and the two-panel layout (keyboard left, results right) is clear and usable.
figma_make_prompt:
Build a TV search screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: Android TV, 1920x1080 base frame.
No top app bar. Full-screen two-panel layout. Persistent collapsed side nav on the far left (same as tv-home.json, 60dp).

Layout:
- Left panel (500dp wide, excluding side nav): 
  - Search input at the top: full panel width, 64dp height, radius 32px, background #1E1E2E, border 2px #6366F1 when focused. Placeholder: "What are you looking for?" (Body Large 20sp #6B7280). Entered text: Body Large 20sp #FFFFFF.
  - On-screen keyboard below the input: QWERTY grid. Each key is a square button 72x72dp, background #1E1E2E, border 1px #333333, radius 8px. Key label centred (Body Medium 18sp #FFFFFF). 8px gap between keys. Focus ring: 4px solid primary #6366F1 on the focused key.
  - Action key row below the letter grid: "Search" (primary filled #6366F1, 180x64dp, white Body Medium 18sp), "Space" (outlined, 260x64dp), "Backspace" (outlined, 140x64dp). Each has a 4px focus ring when focused.
- Right panel (remaining width):
  - Idle state: centred prompt "Start typing to search" (Body Medium 18sp #FFFFFF at 60 % opacity).
  - Results state: grid of title cards 220x300dp, 28px gap. Each card: cover image, title at the bottom on a gradient, Body Medium 18sp #FFFFFF. Focus ring 4px primary on the focused card.

States:
- Idle: input empty, placeholder visible, keyboard visible, right panel shows prompt.
- Typing: input shows entered characters, results update in real time on the right.
- Results: right panel populated with a card grid.
- No results: right panel shows "No titles found. Try different keywords." centred (Body Medium 18sp #FFFFFF).

Behavior:
- D-pad navigates the keyboard. Select types the key or triggers the action.
- D-pad select on "Search" → move focus to the results panel.
- D-pad in results → navigate the card grid.
- D-pad select on a card → navigate to TV Playback.
- D-pad left from the keyboard → move focus to side nav.

Style:
- Dark theme. Background #0F0F1A. Key background #1E1E2E. Primary #6366F1. Text #FFFFFF. Auto layout.

First step: results state with a query entered in the input, keyboard visible on the left, and 6+ result cards in the grid on the right with the first card focused.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the TV search screen is displayed
When the user navigates the keyboard with the D-pad
Then focus moves between keys with a visible 4px ring and characters are typed correctly

Given search results are shown
When focus moves to the results panel
Then the card grid is navigable with the D-pad and the focused card has a 4px primary ring

Given no results match the query
When the results panel updates
Then a helpful message is shown — the panel is not blank
manual_validation_checklist: Verify keyboard keys are 72x72dp with 8px gaps and 18sp labels
Confirm focus ring (4px primary) is visible on every key and on every result card
Check panel widths: left panel 500dp (excluding side nav), right panel fills remaining space
Verify the idle prompt on the right panel is centred and legible at 18sp
Confirm Search, Space, and Backspace action keys are visually distinct from letter keys (filled vs outlined)
